name: @sos-2/ask
description: SOS 2.0 Structured ASK (Work Order W10): the routing/presentation layer on top of @sos-2/authority's first-class AskRequest contract (consumed, never redefined). AskQueue — ordered (severity first, FIFO within severity), deduplicated by the origin decision's exact input digest; escalation context assembly — everything a decider needs to see (the decision request + typed alternatives + evidence summary with freshness + uncertainty + risk + the authority-insufficiency reason); and resolution handling — an ASK resolved by a human/authority decision produces a DecisionRecord through @sos-2/decision's record machinery with the provenance of who resolved it. ASK is a SUCCESS state: an AskRequest is a valid first-class outcome, never an exception (spec/architecture.md sections 3, 5, 18; spec/requirements.md R16; spec/architecture-lock.md).
